1.details: Create timestamped backup before any modifications. Atomic writes after enrichment.

2.content: Add display_name field for all 354 assets
2.details: Human-readable display_name. Preserve canonical_asset_id separately. Examples: akash -> Akash Network, bittensor -> Bittensor, internet-computer -> Internet Computer, mina-protocol -> Mina Protocol, aleph-im -> Aleph.im, ankr-network -> Ankr, crust-network -> Crust Network, render-token -> Render, helium -> Helium

3.content: Add GitHub verified mapping (github_org/repo with provenance)
3.details: For each canonical asset determine: github_org, github_repo, github_url, mapping_status, mapping_confidence, mapping_source. Never infer from ticker. For verified repos: commits_30d, commits_90d, contributors, releases_90d, last_commit_at, stars, forks, open_issues, repository_updated_at, developer_activity_status, retrieved_at. Use .value/.source/.retrieved_at/.status structure. NOT 0 if not available.

4.details: CHAIN / PROTOCOL / APPLICATION / INFRASTRUCTURE / TOKEN_ONLY / NO_TOKEN for each canonical asset. Drives DefiLlama applicability.

5.content: Add DefiLlama metrics (TVL, fees, revenue) with provenance
5.details: Where applicable: TVL, TVL change 7d/30d, fees 24h/7d/30d, revenue 24h/7d/30d, chain/protocol identifier, last_updated. Do not fabricate Users from TVL or Revenue from Fees.

6.content: Update canonical-normalizer.js to expose new semantics
6.details: Add display_name to canonical view. Expose developer.github object with .status (AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE) and .metrics with .value/.source/.retrieved_at. Same for defillama.tvl/fees/revenue.
